request: Prioritize informative deformation, validated nonlinear mechanics and numerically converged reference inference before network complexity.

population_audit.scope: Retrospective all32 sealed objects, A/B, proper rigid removal, objective strain, no population inference from one object.
population_audit.role: diagnosis only; original sealed results preserved

excitation_and_mechanics.scope: Prospective known force families, factorized E/fixture stiffness, finite strain, same-control temporal and spatial checks.
excitation_and_mechanics.gate: Explicit nonrigid amplitude/strain, positive Jacobian, residual, refinement, and material/support sensitivity criteria; failures retained.

reference_posterior.scope: Same saved linear manufactured observation/prior first; conditional2D reference before full4D continuous inference.
reference_posterior.gate: Independent quadrature tolerances, continuous sampler agreement, multiple seeds/counts, chain rank and tail diagnostics plus marginal CDF/quantile stability; effective weights alone insufficient.

interpretation: Finite-model numerical validation does not establish population calibration, native-Isaac equivalence or active-policy superiority. Any later comparison needs fresh held-out cases.
